label: BOMBARDIERI
comment: T.Bombardieri crack (csdb 147560): the FALCON! file of the disk ($2000-$6000), loaded by the BASIC boot FALCON PATROL and started with SYS 16640. It holds the clean game file, as most other cracks do.

label: DERBYSHIRE_RAM
comment: Derbyshire Ram "Falcon Patrol +" (csdb 161485, "cracked 1983"): a packed file with a text intro and the question INFINITE LIVES ? [Y/N] at $0c00. Captured at $4100 after the answer Y, range $2000-$6000. The game was dumped after it had run: its charset holds run state.

label: RGR
comment: RGR (csdb 207856): a $0801-$6009 memory dump of the running game with the BASIC line POKE157,128:SYS16640 ***RGR***. Captured at $4100, range $2000-$6000. RGR changed the credit text VIRGIN to MIKE, and the charset holds run state.
